name: Bear Like Button
description: Animated like button with a counter. Clicking it makes a bear paw slap the button, which morphs into a heart with confetti-like line bursts and rolls the count up by one.
contents: Button with label, heart and bear paw icon, and a two-digit counter
Hidden celebration lines, slap ring and burst effects shown on click
behavior: Hover slides the paw in and fades the label
Click triggers a paw slap, ripple, colorful line burst and morph into a pink heart with the count incremented
Clicking again resets the button to its idle state
Celebration colors are randomized on each click

needsCodeEdit.where: RESIZE_TL and RESET_TL timelines inside the useEffect

needsCodeEdit.change: Change button size or font size
needsCodeEdit.where: SEGMENT constant and the transformer button className
Array.from calls for Wiggle and Dashed in the render

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Loads the Roboto font through a Google Fonts link element
Counter supports two digits and shows the initial count plus one when liked
